scope: Independent read-only corroboration of existing Docker/Colima container state and host TCP/HTTP reachability; no browser launch or Playwright runner was started by this reviewer.
version_resolution_limitation: Direct top-level require('playwright/package.json') and require('playwright-core/package.json') failed under pnpm's isolated dependency layout; this was not evidence of a version mismatch. The clinical reviewer separately verified the actual client/server 1.62.1 connection and Firefox 153.0 launch.
clinical_review_reported_result: Actual browser/data-URL and unchanged localhost login HTTP200 probes passed in 832 ms. The initial outer timeout came after browser/context close because the one-shot Node process retained network-bridge handles; the final explicit-exit probe exited zero in less than one second. This browser observation belongs to the clinical reviewer, not this transport-only corroboration.
